rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A command execution server that provides secure shell command execution, directory navigation, and interactive program automation through pexpect integration. Built by Jon Allen, it features configurable command blocking and file access restrictions via TOML configuration, with safety controls that can be overridden when needed. The server includes tools for running shell commands with stdin support, changing directories with environment variable expansion, and automating interactive programs through expect/send sequences. Useful for system administration tasks, development workflows, and command-line tool interaction while maintaining security boundaries through customizable restrictions on dangerous commands and sensitive files.
